verdict.rationale: Box documents a real REST API at https://api.box.com/2.0 with OAuth 2.0 tokens and a curl quick-start. It also documents a Chunked Upload API for large files, so upload over documented endpoints is clearly evidenced. The other operations in the story are not shown as endpoints: download appears only indirectly, as a webhook event, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: explicit documented endpoints for download, list, move and delete; a machine-readable OpenAPI spec; independent hands-on corroboration of file operations via the API.
